paragraphs: A small green island appears in a big lake in Canada. The island has green trees. But it floats on the water.

People saw it in July. A few days later, it is gone. At the end of August, the island comes back again. Experts say that trees grow on wood near the water for many years. When the lake water gets high, the trees and wood begin to float.
When the island goes away, it just moves across the water to another side of the lake. That is why people sometimes see it, and sometimes they do not.

words.d: when you start to see something
to move on top of water

paragraphs: A mysterious floating island covered with growing trees has recently appeared in Williston Lake, Canada, which surprised both residents and experts.

A resident captured video footage of the unusual island in July, but it vanished just a few days later, a movement confirmed by satellite imagery. The mystery deepened on August 31, when the island was photographed again in the reservoir. Experts believe the phenomenon was created over many years. Trees had been growing undisturbed on piles of woody debris along the shoreline. Recently, rising water levels in the reservoir lifted the heavy mass of wood and soil and set it free to float across the water.

Representatives of the government utility managing the dam suggest that during the periods when the island seemed to disappear, it had simply drifted back toward the shore or moved out of view before floating away again.

words.d: something strange or unusual that can be seen
a company that provides a public service, such as electricity, water, or gas

paragraphs: In July, a floating island with trees on it appeared in a lake in Canada. Local people were very surprised, and satellite pictures showed that the island quickly disappeared a few days later.
At the end of August, a resident saw the island again and took a photo. Experts believe they know why this happened. For many years, trees grew on wood and dirt near the water’s edge.

The experts explained that when the water level in the lake went up, it lifted the ground and set the small island free to float on the water. When people couldn’t see it, the island probably just floated to a different shore. This makes sense, but for many people, it is still something mysterious.

words.d: to go away from a place so that you cannot be seen
the land along the edge of a lake, sea, or river
strange or difficult to understand or explain
